description: Named UI controls and the browser spec test that proves each one. ui/check_ui_contract.py fails when a spec file is missing or no test title in it contains the named text. A mapping is not behavioural evidence: the browser groups that run these specs are.

approach-22.test: @retained source inspection keeps unsaved form and exact binding

units-01.test: new ports remain unspecified in saved drafts and read-only versions; configurations blocked

units-02.test: catalog choices save explicit dimensionless and compound spelling; invalid text and dirty navigation survive

units-03.test: unavailable negotiation never downgrades and retry keeps model name

units-04.test: lost acknowledgement keeps exact typed receipt and reloads committed result

units-05.test: new ports remain unspecified in saved drafts and read-only versions; configurations blocked

units-06.test: incomplete immutable version identifies and opens exact active quantity

units-07.test: incomplete immutable version identifies and opens exact active quantity

units-08.test: explicit input units use the public catalog; configuration 6 carries no criteria

units-09.test: invalid spelling, incompatible proof and catalog outage keep local edits

units-10.test: actual seven native records retain exact values and modified seeds during real outage

units-11.test: saved model revision requires explicit new version and preserves draft

units-12.test: new ports remain unspecified in saved drafts and read-only versions; configurations blocked

editor-guard-04.test: @ae-evidence workspace guard keeps a refused evidence draft and saves a valid one before leaving

editor-guard-05.test: @ae-evidence workspace guard Discard drops the evidence draft and leaves

editor-guard-06.test: @units-authoring editor guard refused editor save keeps unit text and focuses the source editor

editor-guard-07.test: @units-authoring editor guard Save applies a pending component edit once and skips the separate editor save

run-outcomes-03.test: run outcomes are Execution and Criteria only; unread, unresulted and unknown states are never success

assumptions-01.test: @ae-model component assumptions show statement and evidence rows with one empty state and no owner line or notes

assumptions-02.test: @ae-configuration configuration lists its own assumptions and links once to the model assumptions

assumptions-03.test: @ae-model component assumptions apply locally, preview exact uses and preserve independent instances

assumptions-04.test: @modified inherited context notes, stale review and exact origin save

model-view-02.test: run Model tab and saved configuration View model version reuse the canonical model view with values

model-view-03.test: @ae-configuration configuration lists its own assumptions and links once to the model assumptions

evidence-index-01.test: @ae-evidence referenced library preserves exact membership with partial reads and confirmed denial

evidence-index-03.test: @ae-configuration run artifact and modified-run seed reads clear the run on a confirmed denial and retry a transient probe

evidence-index-04.test: @ae-configuration export status read clears on a confirmed denial

attribution-01.test: Home marks agent-created studies, active and archived, and no person-created study

attribution-02.test: a study heading names the agent that created it; a person-created study has none

attribution-03.test: Overview marks a description an agent wrote, not one a person wrote since

attribution-04.test: model headings and Record details name the agent that wrote the draft or version

answer-01.test: answers cite analyses and retain exact history

answer-02.test: fresh briefs appear and missing evidence stays explicit

calculation-01.test: each run reads against the brief criteria

calculation-02.test: samples expose their design, points, runs and estimates
